title: Photorealistic cinematic vertical smartp
prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic vertical smartphone selfie of four young East Asian women in their early twenties, around 20 years old, standing closely together outdoors during a torrential summer rainstorm at a school sports festival or athletic-field event. The woman nearest the camera occupies the right foreground, holding the phone at arm’s length from a slightly elevated, wide-angle perspective. She has fair luminous skin covered with fine rain droplets, a softly oval face, large dark brown eyes looking directly into the lens, naturally shaped brows, a small straight nose, and slightly parted pink lips with a candid, mildly surprised expression. Her long black hair is completely soaked, hanging in separated strands across her forehead, cheeks, neck, shoulders, and chest. She wears a saturated fitted white short-sleeved crew-neck athletic T-shirt, visibly wet and clinging naturally to her body, tied in a knot at the lower front to expose a narrow strip of midriff, paired with fitted white athletic shorts.

Three friends cluster behind and beside her. The center woman has fair skin, wet medium-brown hair styled in loose braids, closed smiling eyes, and a broad joyful laugh. She leans toward the camera while extending one arm forward, wearing a soaked fitted white V-neck short-sleeved athletic top and snug white shorts. Behind her, another woman wears black rectangular eyeglasses and has wet dark-brown hair loosely tied back, stray strands framing her face. She looks toward the lens with a slightly overwhelmed but amused expression, one hand pressed against the top of her head and the other resting across her lower abdomen. She wears a wet pale-white scoop-neck athletic T-shirt with a faint circular emblem on the chest and white shorts. On the left, the fourth woman bends inward from the edge of the frame, smiling softly with her head tilted. She has long soaked black hair, large dark eyes, fair skin, a fitted wet white short-sleeved athletic shirt, white shorts, and white sneakers.

Their full-body poses feel spontaneous, affectionate, energetic, and slightly chaotic. Heavy diagonal rain streaks fill the scene, splashing across the muddy, waterlogged sports field and forming reflective puddles around their shoes. In the hazy background are rows of white event tents, red-and-white flags, groups of people in pale blue rain ponchos, distant trees, and blurred festival structures. Capture with a 24mm-equivalent smartphone ultra-wide lens, close focus, subtle edge distortion, natural handheld framing, realistic wet fabric texture, fine skin detail, cool overcast daylight, soft diffused highlights, muted blue-grey color grading, restrained contrast, atmospheric rain haze, and authentic candid social-media photography. 9:16
